channel.description: Latest articles from The Old House Life (theoldhouselife.com)

item.title: A lot of house for the money! Five acres in Alabama. $529,900
item.description: This seems like a lot of house for the money! The house was built in 1922. It is located on five acres in Gadsden, Alabama. The house features a stone exterior, amazing chimney, large back patio, wood floors, paneled wainscoting, soaring ceilings, unique fireplace, huge sunroom, updated kitchen, updated bathrooms and amazing views. There is an attached garage and an in-ground pool. Four bedrooms, four bathrooms and 4,076 square feet. $529,900 Contact Susie Weems with Susie Weems Real Estate: 256

item.title: Country living! Seven acres in Arkansas with Pecan Trees. $279,900
item.description: Country living! There are pecan trees on the property. Nice acreage! The house was built in 1932. It is located on seven acres in Earle, Arkansas. The house features a screened in side porch, hardwood floors, big fireplace, crown moulding, baseboards, spacious kitchen with pressed tin ceiling and a bathroom with vintage tile. There is a basement and outbuildings. Six bedrooms, three bathrooms and 3,500 square feet. $279,900 Contact Jason Nichols with Cross Country Realty: 501-951-7170 From the Z

item.title: Pretty interior! Large outbuilding! Over an acre in Virginia. $289,000
item.description: This house has a really pretty interior! So much natural light! Love the big outbuilding and the long driveway. The house was built in 1930. It is located on 1.39 acres in Dublin, Virginia. The house features wood floors, brick fireplace, baseboards, solid wood doors, spacious kitchen, built-in shelving, pretty kitchen sink, nice staircase and a lot of natural light. There is a basement and a couple of outbuildings. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,429 square feet. $289,000 Contact Michael Mc

item.title: Rustic, but cozy! Circa 1950 in California. $460,000
item.description: This cabin looks rustic, but cozy! I like the big foot sign over the kitchen sink. The cabin was built in 1950. It is located Shaver Lake, California. The cabin features a large deck, knotty pine, wainscoting and a wood stove. I wonder if there are wood floors underneath the carpeting? The cabin is situated in the heart of West Village and is within walking distance to town, shops, restaurants and local amenities. Two bedrooms, one bathroom and 854 square feet. $460,000 Contact Kimberly L. Hogue

item.title: Unique! Views of Mt. Sopris! Almost ten acres in Colorado. $1,590,000
item.description: This sure is a unique house! I’m curious how it looked originally. Pretty views of Mt. Sopris! The house was built in 1917. It is located on 9.7 acres in Carbondale, Colorado. The house could definitely use some undoing of past renovations and a bit of updating. Would be interesting to see what someone with vision could do with this property. Two bedrooms, one bathroom and 1,367 square feet. $1,590,000 From the Zillow listing: Vision and Views! Mt Sopris views, 9.7 Acres, no subdivision, no HOA.

item.title: This is pretty cool! C. 1956. Over an acre in Colorado. $499,000
item.description: Now this is pretty cool! Not sure if I would want to live there full time, but it is a neat spot. It was built from trees that were on the land. The house was constructed in 1956. It is located on 1.43 acres in Conifer, Colorado. The house features a large deck, stone exterior stairs, wood floors, exposed beams, updated kitchen, amazing views and an updated bathroom. There are a couple of outbuildings on the property, including a greenhouse. Two bedrooms, one bathroom and 994 square feet. $499,0

item.title: Look at the woodwork! Circa 1892 in Connecticut. $375,000
item.description: Take a look at that beautiful woodwork! Love the staircase and the ceiling! The house was built in 1892. It is located in Derby, Connecticut. The house features a wrap around porch, an attached garage, pretty staircase, original millwork, wainscoting, beautiful ceilings, crown moulding, wide baseboards, leaded glass, arched entryways, picture rails, pocket doors, exposed beams and a spacious kitchen. Seven bedrooms, three bathrooms and 3,327 square feet. $375,000 Contact Barbara Zink with Coldwe

item.title: Pretty setting! Circa 1953 in Florida. $319,000
item.description: This has a pretty setting and a pretty backyard pool! The home is situated on the banks of the Braden River. The house was built in 1953. It is located in Bradenton, Florida. The house features a back deck overlooking the pool, wood floors, wood walls, knotty pine, fireplace, claw foot tub and lots of windows to take in the view! One bedroom, one bathroom and 898 square feet. $319,000 Contact Tracy Anderson with Preferred Shore: 214-621-6128 From the Zillow listing: Escape to your own private wa

item.title: Connecticut’s most expensive old house listing! Hillandale, C. 1900. On 268 acres. $75,000,000
item.description: Wow! Welcome to Connecticut’s most expensive old house listing! I have no words for this one! That indoor pool is pretty amazing! This is known as Hillandale. It was originally owned by the Sulzberger Family of the New York Times. Hillandale was built in 1900. It is located on 268 acres in Stamford, Connecticut. item.title: Fixer Upper Alert! Circa 1890. On 15 acres in Georgia. $299,999
item.description: This is definitely a fixer upper! There is potential there though and it has some nice acreage. The house was built in 1890. It is located on 15 acres in Sparta, Georgia. The house features a large covered front porch, tall ceilings, crown moulding, nice staircase, wide baseboards, chair rails, built-in china cabinet and bead board. There are multiple outbuildings , mature hardwood trees and open pastures. Six bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,731 square feet. $299,999 Contact Wallace Hardy with Jas
